title: A Space's Circle with no cover of its own wears its Space's page header image, on its page and on its card in the Circles library

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14 (Circles library screenshot): make sure the header image from a page carries over as the default circle header.

detail: Most Space default Circles carry no image_url, so their page cover fell to the operator's generic /circles image and their library card to a placeholder, though their Space has a header photo. The Circle read (lib/circles/store.ts) and the library read (lib/circles/index-data.ts) now also select the Space's cover_image_url, and both the identity hero's entity image and the card image fall back to it when the Circle has none (never the platform root's). A Circle's own cover still wins.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const l=fs.readFileSync('app/(main)/circles/[slug]/(circle)/layout.tsx','utf8'),i=fs.readFileSync('lib/circles/index-data.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(!l.includes('circle.space.cover_image_url'))bad.push('a Space Circle page does not fall back to its Space header');if(!i.includes('c.space.cover_image_url'))bad.push('a Space Circle card does not fall back to its Space header');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-898: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
